info.title: GeoAPI
info.description: Public catalog API. Send Authorization: Bearer geoapi_sk_… from your server. List responses keep data and meta, and add collection. limit defaults to 100 and cannot exceed 1000. per_page is an alias used only when limit is absent. Fuel consumption is litres per 100 km. Dimensions and performance groups are null because those columns are not stored. Colors return every stored row with a verified flag. Document version 1.2.0 matches the deployed catalog. The TypeScript SDK is packages/sdk-js 0.1.0 in this repository and is not on the public npm registry. MCP and CLI are not published. The host is https://geoapi.ge.

tags.name: Catalog
tags.description: Public read-only vehicle catalog. GET only.

secretKey.description: Server key geoapi_sk_…. geoapi_pk_, query strings, cookies, and a cabinet session are not this credential.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Page size. Default 100. per_page is ignored when limit is present.

perPage.name: per_page
perPage.description: Alias of limit. Ignored when limit is present.

direction.name: direction
direction.description: asc or desc. Default asc. Applied when sort is set.

q.name: q
q.description: Case-insensitive name search, 1 to 100 characters. Control characters are rejected. Not accepted on years.

modifiedAfter.name: modified_after
modifiedAfter.description: UTC timestamp. Returns rows whose modified value is newer. Example 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z. Not accepted on years or bodies.

yearFrom.name: year_from
yearFrom.description: Inclusive overlap with stored year_start and year_end. Integer from 1886 to 2100. Not a column.

yearTo.name: year_to
yearTo.description: Inclusive overlap with stored year_start and year_end. Integer from 1886 to 2100. Use with year_from.

body.name: body
body.description: Stored body type, up to 64 characters.

fuel.name: fuel
fuel.description: Stored fuel type, up to 64 characters.

drive.name: drive
drive.description: Stored drive type, up to 64 characters.

brandId.name: brand_id
brandId.description: Positive integer id from a brand response. Zero is rejected.

modelId.name: model_id
modelId.description: Positive integer id from a model response. Zero is rejected.

volumeFrom.name: volume_from
volumeFrom.description: Minimum engine volume in cubic centimetres, from 1 to 20000.

volumeTo.name: volume_to
volumeTo.description: Maximum engine volume in cubic centimetres, from 1 to 20000.

dimensions.description: Always null. Dimension columns are not stored.

performance.description: Always null. Performance columns are not stored. power_hp stays on engine.

get.description:
Brand list.

Pagination: page defaults to 1 (maximum 1000000). limit defaults to 100 and cannot exceed 1000. per_page is used only when limit is absent. direction defaults to asc and applies when sort is set. Omitting sort keeps this resource's default order. REST year lists are ascending. The widget list is newest-first.

Authentication: Authorization: Bearer geoapi_sk_… from your server. Query strings, cookies, and a cabinet session are not credentials. geoapi_pk_ is the widget key, not a catalog bearer. Sanctum cars:read or * also requires X-CARAPI-PROJECT naming that user's active project. A secret key ignores X-CARAPI-PROJECT.

Errors, JSON error.code and error.message only, no request id: 401 unauthorized, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 405 method_not_allowed, 422 invalid_parameter, 429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED or DAILY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED or MONTHLY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED, 503 unavailable. Authentication runs before the method check. A non-GET request without an accepted key is 401, not 405. 405 is returned only after the key is accepted. Use GET.

Limits: one project shares 60 requests each UTC minute and 10 000 successful requests each UTC month with the widget. Those caps are active. The 2 000 successful requests per UTC day limit is not enforced in production today, because the daily check runs only when platform.project_limits.per_day exists. A missing limits row or a failed meter is 503, not an unmetered success. 401, 403, 404, 405, 422, 429, and 503 do not spend the month. Failures still use the minute window. On 429, wait Retry-After seconds. Do not retry 401, 403, 404, or 422. Success sends X-RateLimit-* for the minute and X-Quota-* for the month. 429 sends X-RateLimit-* for the window that was hit.

Coverage: JSON ids are strings. null means the stored value is missing. dimensions and performance are null. Colors include unverified rows with verified false. Photo files and VIN are not on these routes. Photo rights are not established.

Version 1.2.0 at https://geoapi.ge. The TypeScript SDK is packages/sdk-js 0.1.0 in this repository and is not on the public npm registry. MCP and CLI are not published. The widget is the browser embed and uses geoapi_pk_.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Optional. One of name, id, modified. direction applies when sort is set.

401.description: The key is missing, unknown, revoked, or expired.

403.description: The key is valid, but the project, owner, or email does not allow the call.

422.description: A parameter is invalid or is not accepted on this route.

503.description: The catalog or the meter is temporarily unavailable.

x-codeSamples.source:
curl https://geoapi.ge/api/v1/brands?limit=1 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer geoapi_sk_…"

import urllib.request
request = urllib.request.Request("https://geoapi.ge/api/v1/brands?limit=1", headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer geoapi_sk_…'})
print(urllib.request.urlopen(request).read().decode())

get.summary: Engine volume, fuel, and power stored on modifications
get.description:
Engine volume, fuel, and power stored on a modification. Filter with fuel, brand_id, model_id, volume_from, and volume_to. There is no engines table.

Pagination: page defaults to 1 (maximum 1000000). limit defaults to 100 and cannot exceed 1000. per_page is used only when limit is absent. direction defaults to asc and applies when sort is set. Omitting sort keeps this resource's default order. REST year lists are ascending. The widget list is newest-first.

Authentication: Authorization: Bearer geoapi_sk_… from your server. Query strings, cookies, and a cabinet session are not credentials. geoapi_pk_ is the widget key, not a catalog bearer. Sanctum cars:read or * also requires X-CARAPI-PROJECT naming that user's active project. A secret key ignores X-CARAPI-PROJECT.

Errors, JSON error.code and error.message only, no request id: 401 unauthorized, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 405 method_not_allowed, 422 invalid_parameter, 429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED or DAILY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED or MONTHLY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED, 503 unavailable. Authentication runs before the method check. A non-GET request without an accepted key is 401, not 405. 405 is returned only after the key is accepted. Use GET.

Limits: one project shares 60 requests each UTC minute and 10 000 successful requests each UTC month with the widget. Those caps are active. The 2 000 successful requests per UTC day limit is not enforced in production today, because the daily check runs only when platform.project_limits.per_day exists. A missing limits row or a failed meter is 503, not an unmetered success. 401, 403, 404, 405, 422, 429, and 503 do not spend the month. Failures still use the minute window. On 429, wait Retry-After seconds. Do not retry 401, 403, 404, or 422. Success sends X-RateLimit-* for the minute and X-Quota-* for the month. 429 sends X-RateLimit-* for the window that was hit.

Coverage: JSON ids are strings. null means the stored value is missing. dimensions and performance are null. Colors include unverified rows with verified false. Photo files and VIN are not on these routes. Photo rights are not established.
